name: Quaker Crossing Retail Center
summary: Quaker Crossing Retail Center is a neighborhood shopping destination in Orchard Park, NY, offering convenient access to national retailers and dining options. With a strong 4.3-star rating from thousands of reviews, the center serves as a reliable community hub for the southern Buffalo suburbs.
demographics: Quaker Crossing Retail Center serves the affluent suburban community of Orchard Park, NY, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes above the regional average. The trade area draws heavily from professional families aged 35-65 who value convenience and quality in their shopping experiences. Visitors typically combine quick service dining stops with retail errands, reflecting the busy lifestyles of working parents and retirees in this established Buffalo suburb. The center benefits from strong daytime traffic from nearby office parks and residential neighborhoods seeking accessible retail options.
description: Quaker Crossing Retail Center is a convenient shopping destination located in the heart of Orchard Park, New York, serving the southern suburbs of Buffalo. Situated at 3420 Amelia Drive, this retail center has established itself as a reliable neighborhood gathering place for residents seeking quality retail and dining options. The center features a mix of national retailers and service providers designed to meet the everyday needs of the local community. With its accessible location and ample parking, Quaker Crossing offers a hassle-free shopping experience for busy families and professionals. The center maintains a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.3-star rating from nearly 3,000 customer reviews, demonstrating consistent satisfaction with the shopping experience and tenant offerings.
